Locates emit/observe and ignorable:true; folding analysis correctly maps removal (alpha.1) superseded by restoration (alpha.2), net zero, keep the marker; no Session.append claim.
apiProxy usage and removal located precisely, but the Host llm injection/listProviders replacement vs Web Client Remote distinction is not made; replacement left as unknown.
Fixed ~/.dsh/profiles/default path and write coupling located, but the fix is generic ('derive from the host'); runtime DSH_HOME/profile information is not named.
Both the deep /internal SessionView import and registerCommand located; explains module-resolution failure, unknown new signature, and verifying against target public seams.
Locates loopback server on 43121; explains it bypasses Gateway auth and must become a Gateway-authenticated channel rather than a raw route; dead code still a hit.

Both dsh call sites and JSON.parse located with final-text consequence, but stderr-progress is not explained and the JSONL break is attributed to an alpha.2 stdout change instead of being already wrong.

Coupling-to-change mappings are substantively argued per touchpoint, but card IDs are self-invented (A2-02/A2-06/A2-08/A2-09) and collide with registry semantics (its A1-03 means the CLI surface); required A1-04 mapping absent.
All seven hits accounted with per-category ruled-out inventories and good scan-limit caveats, but no proposed target-version build/typecheck, isolated boot, or functional verification path.
